espr.name: 🌿 DROS-ESPR-DPP Package
espr.desc: EU Cross-Border Supply Chain Carbon Passport Zero-Knowledge Shield. Resolves the trade-off between EU ESPR (DPP) transparency mandates and proprietary BOM secret exfiltration! Produces verifiable carbon proofs.
espr.details:
🎯 Target Regulations: EU ESPR 2024/1781, EU CBAM, ISO 14040/44 LCA Carbon Standards

🛡️ Core Mechanisms

  • In-Band Zero-Knowledge Field Redaction: 14+ proprietary BOM fields (baking temperatures, material costs, formulation ratios) are physically overwritten in memory before TCP packet assembly — they never leave the server.
  • Verifiable Carbon Proof Output: Only SHA-256 signed aggregate CO2e values and CBAM-compliant certificate IDs are returned. EU auditors can independently verify without accessing raw manufacturing data.
  • Scope-Declarative Authorization Matrix: vajra_policy.yaml statically declares permitted/prohibited field access. Compiled to binary lookup at build time — no regex, no runtime string matching.
  • HITL Dual-Signature Gate: High-risk queries (e.g. full BOM export attempts) auto-trigger human approval flow; requests remain suspended until plant manager signs off.

📦 Includes: ESPR Compliance VEP Control Panel UI Template + vajra_policy.yaml Carbon Passport Redaction Rules + Installation README

fintech.name: 💳 DROS-FinRisk-Privacy Package
fintech.desc: FinTech Cross-Institutional Anti-Money Laundering & Anonymized Risk Gate. Operates strictly on anonymized behavioral vectors, providing 26.1μs in-band circuit-breaking and O(1) Token freezing.
fintech.details:
🎯 Target Regulations: GDPR Article 5(f), PDPA (Taiwan), AML / FATF Travel Rule, MAS TRM, FinCEN BSA

🛡️ Core Mechanisms

  • In-Band De-identification & Behavioral Vector Conversion: Raw transaction records (name, SSN, card number, line items) are read in memory and immediately converted to statistical behavioral metrics (frequency, amount variance, fan-out node count). PII fields are physically zeroed before TCP packet assembly — the risk AI model never receives raw PII.
  • 26.1μs In-Band AML Circuit-Breaker: Fan-out mule pattern detected (e.g. 20+ recipients in 3 mins with near-identical amounts) triggers INTERCEPT_AND_SUSPEND within 26.1 microseconds. Payment held pending human confirmation.
  • O(1) RCU Token Instant Freeze: Single-click freeze via RCU atomic pointer swap completes token revocation. All subsequent payment API calls receive 403 FORBIDDEN with total latency < 1 second.

📦 Includes: FinTech Risk VEP Control Panel UI Template + vajra_policy.yaml Privacy Vector Rules + Installation README

health.name: 🏥 DROS-Health-HIPAA Package
health.desc: Healthcare PHI Redaction & Patient Consent Governance Shield. Compliant with US HIPAA & EU EHDS. Features dynamic PHI de-identification and patient e-consent token verification.
health.details:
🎯 Target Regulations: US HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514 (Safe Harbor De-identification), EU EHDS (European Health Data Space), Taiwan Medical Data Privacy Law

🛡️ Core Mechanisms

  • Dynamic PHI Redaction Filter: Based on HIPAA Safe Harbor 18-identifier checklist, the VEP automatically redacts patient name, SSN, address, phone, DOB and other sensitive fields before EHR / HL7 / FHIR API response packaging. Only de-identified diagnostic summaries and lab results are returned.
  • Patient E-Consent Token Dynamic Validation: Before each cross-hospital AI Agent query, VEP validates the patient's signed e-consent token (Scope & expiry). Unauthorized queries are hard-rejected in-band within 26.1μs.
  • Cross-Hospital Agent Action Boundary Enforcement: Medical AI Agents are physically restricted to get_diagnosis_summary(). Any attempt to read full EHR or transmit raw PHI cross-institution is circuit-broken at the VEP binary layer.

📦 Includes: Healthcare VEP Control Panel UI Template + vajra_policy.yaml PHI De-identification Rules + Installation README
